crossRefs.note: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing…

translations.web: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.
translations.bsb: Far from human habitation he cuts a shaft in places forgotten by the foot of man. Far from men he dangles and sways.
translations.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
translations.asv: He breaketh open a shaft away from where men sojourn; They are forgotten of the foot; They hang afar from men, they swing to and fro.
